newsitem.title: USA: Advanced NMR unit in definitive merger deal.
newsitem.headline: Advanced NMR unit in definitive merger deal.

text.p: Advanced NMR Systems Inc said on Monday its unit, Medical Diagnostics Inc, will merge with a newly-formed subsidiary of U.S. Diagnostic Inc.
Under a definitive agreement, Advanced NMR said it will receive about $22 million in cash, including $12 million to be used to repay bank debt.
The merger will give U.S. Diagnostic a medical imaging services business with facilities in Massachusetts, New York, Virginia, West Virginia and Tennessee, Advanced NMR said.
Advanced NMR said it will continue to own and operate Medical Diagnostic's rehabilitation business and to own an interest in Faulkner Hospital's Sagoff Women's Center, which is under development.
It said it will also continue to own and operate its medical imaging technology business and to own a stake in Advanced Mammography Systems Inc.

Jack Nelson, chairman and chief executive officer of Advanced NMR, said the transaction, combined with the cost-cutting in the past few months in technology operations "gives us the financial security and liquidity to invest in our rehabilitation business."

Nelson said Advanced NMR's financial position, weakened by continuing losses from the technology operation has not allowed the company to invest in the services business or in other businesses of Medical Diagnostic, which it acquired in 1995.
The deal with U.S. Diagnostic is expected to close as soon as government approvals are received, including federal anti-trust clearance, a company statement said.
